gbm_population_evidence.quote: Participants must have radiologic evidence of anaplastic astrocytoma or glioblastoma multiforme within 14 days of enrollment.

candidate_evidence.quote: It will evaluate whether an antiseizure medication decreases hyperexcitability activity around tumors and prevents seizures.
Perampanel is expected to decrease abnormal brain activity and prevent seizures by blocking AMPA receptor signaling.
Seizure-free rates were assessed from the time of initial glioma resection to radiographic tumor progression or up to a maximum of 12 months.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Pilot Study of Perampanel on Peritumoral Hyperexcitability and Seizure Control in Newly Diagnosed High Grade Glioma

role_evidence.quote: Perampanel is expected to decrease abnormal brain activity and prevent seizures by blocking AMPA receptor signaling.

Peritumoral hyperexcitability was measured by intraoperative electrocorticography (ECoG) high frequency oscillation (80-500 Hz) rate over 10 minutes within 1 cm of the contrast-enhancing margin at the time of initial glioma resection.
Standard of Care (other names: Standard treatment (typically the anti-seizure medication levetiracetam)): Predetermined standard of care drug and dosing

agents.drug_class_hint: standard antiseizure medication (typically levetiracetam); exact drug not fixed

coder_notes: Perampanel's stated purposes are reduction of peritumoral hyperexcitability (ECoG HFO rate) and seizure prevention; no antitumour hypothesis or antitumour outcome is stated, so coded supportive (rule 2) and trial fails S6. The HFO endpoint is a pharmacodynamic measure for perampanel but perampanel is not a candidate, so target_engagement_planned coded no. Standard-of-care comparator is 'typically levetiracetam'; moiety not fixed. Population includes anaplastic astrocytoma and glioblastoma multiforme (historical terminology).
